faq.title: Common questions.
faq.q1: What does it cost for the buyer?
faq.a1: Light is free (passive search in our network). Spotlight is R$ 2,500, credited at closing — 100% back when you close with us. Hunt is R$ 7,500, also credited. You only bear residual risk if you give up before closing and we haven't delivered the minimum qualified candidates.
faq.q2: What price range do you cover?
faq.a2: From R$ 250k to R$ 5M. We handle first-time, mid and high-end, and investment.
faq.q3: How long until I find my property?
faq.a3: It depends a lot on what you're looking for. On average, first offer in 48h and closing in 30-60 days.
faq.a4: Yes. We work both ways. With exclusivity we invest more in promotion; without it, you share with other agencies.
faq.a5: We're not a bank, but we partner with several and handle all paperwork for you.
faq.a6: Today our focus is on sales. Short-term rentals are case-by-case — we serve on demand but don't have a browsable catalog yet.
faq.a7: Full focus on the state of Rio de Janeiro — capital, metropolitan area, Região dos Lagos, Serra and Costa Verde.
